summary: Comment Management app with User View (Top-Down Shooter game in styled dark card box, Single Comment Generator), Upload, Live Checker, and Admin tabs. Dark space-themed background with floating geometric shapes and Time Until Midnight countdown.
architectural_notes: User View contains: Top-Down Shooter game card + Single Comment Generator section
Navigation tabs: User View, Upload, Live Checker, Admin
Do not modify Upload, Live Checker, or Admin tabs when making User View changes

existing_features.title: In the User View (UserView.tsx), add a dark rounded card box above the Single Comment Generator section that contains: a 'Top-Down Shooter' title (styled in cyan/teal gradient text), instruction text ('Use WASD or Arrow keys to move. Click to shoot. Survive as long as you can!'), and a 'Start Game' button. The card should use the existing dark glass-card style consistent with the app's dark space theme. Clicking 'Start Game' should launch the existing TopDownShooter canvas game inside or below the card.
